data.summary: D128 NIH SBIR prototype provenance fix verified and committed. Key changes: (1) tools/nih_accessibility_prototype.py fetch_grants() now accepts activity_codes parameter and uses meta.total stopping condition instead of arbitrary 2000-row cap; (2) tools/nih_sbir_metrics.py same fix applied. E209 completed: federal IT codes not uniformly enterable (median 0.2677 < 0.30), three codes enterable (DA01/DA10/7A21 at 0.27-0.31), two closed shops (7030/D304 at 0.0); fragmentation does not predict entry (ρ=+0.6669). Analysis logic verified against E207 census data: category 101 reproduces E204 (147 grants, 134 orgs, top5 11.6%). Single most useful next action: explore small-program accessibility pattern in 3rd NIH SBIR spending category (category 176) using fixed prototype methodology with activity_codes filtering and meta.total census, extending pattern from 2 to 3 domains and actualizing the D128 fix.
